set.body:
Phase A (P0 correctness hotfix, no public shape change).

Law: loss after writing the cancellation request can yield only cancellation-unknown, never a safely repeatable invocation failure.

Problem: ssh/Slurm.scala:79-84 does not inspect afterRequestWrite at all —

    case AgentCall.Failed(failure) =>
      invocationFailure(failure).map(CancellationAttempt.InvocationFailed(_))

while the submit path at :54-64 does exactly the right thing, rescuing TransportDisconnected(true, _, _) into Submission.AcceptanceUnknown(TransportInterrupted).

The vocabulary already exists and is unused here: CancellationResult.Unknown (core/FailureModel.scala:38), which the CLI backend already produces on timeout (cli/SlurmCliScheduler.scala:226-236, code "cancellation-acknowledgement-unknown"). This is an SSH-path asymmetry, not a missing concept.

Partial downstream mitigation that does NOT excuse the API defect: managed/ControlTransition.scala:592-601 maps CancellationAttempt.InvocationFailed to ManagedCancellation.Unknown. Any direct Scheduler.cancel consumer still sees a bare SpawnFailed(Unknown).

Acceptance:
- Test mirroring ssh/RemoteSchedulerSuite.scala:9-24 for cancel; no equivalent exists today. RED against parent.
set.title: P8.A3: Honor the cancellation uncertainty law over SSH
